tasks.name: Leave-one-sensor-out cross-validation + calibration floor
tasks.deliverable: tests/_diagnose_loo_cross_validation.py: standalone diagnostic. For each of the 7 real-CSV fixtures and each of two models (M9 Stefan PDE 4-param, M12 Zurcher 5-param), refit using all-but-one in-dough sensor and predict the held-out sensor's time series. Compute held-out RMSE per sensor; aggregate. Also compute sensor calibration floor: spread of T1-T8 readings at t=0 (room temperature, before bake start) per fixture. Append a 'Round 2 — leave-one-sensor-out cross-validation (HMS Hermione)' section to tests/baselines/stefan_inverse_research.md AND tests/baselines/zurcher_two_state_research.md. Output JSON dump at tests/baselines/loo_cross_validation.json with raw per-(fixture, held-out-sensor) RMSE numbers. Revised verdict: GO (LOO-RMSE < 2 °C, model genuinely captures field) / GO-WITH-CAVEATS / CONFIRM-information-limit (LOO matches in-sample).
tasks.validation_required: Driver runs end-to-end without crashes (~30-60 min wall-clock; LOO requires N-1 fits per fixture × 7 fixtures × 2 models). Per-fixture LOO-RMSE table appended to both research reports. Calibration floor table per fixture. Existing M1-M12 tests untouched.
